title: Right-hand image normalization
statement:
For every scheme morphism h, open W and complex I, normalize the RIGHT-hand image-component/restriction-localization expression to Q of the complex composition map b0 followed by the open direct-image localization unit and open derived direct image of the three-map chain consisting of the restricted-direct-image unit, inverse exact X-restriction factor and inverse derived restriction comparison. There is no h-localization unit and no derived composition isomorphism in this conclusion. Definitions: [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-canonical-data], [def-pc-mayer-vietoris-image-chain-data], [def-pc-mayer-vietoris-restriction-localization-chain]. Exact Lean statement:
theorem schemeMV_composition_right_normalization
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (h : X ⟶ Y) (W : Y.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ T : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ T : Y.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) :
    let F := (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage h.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)
    let R := schemeDerivedDirectImage W.ι
    DerivedCategory.Q.map (schemeMVImageComponent h W I (F.obj I) (𝟙 _)) ≫
      schemeMVOpenImageLocalization Y W (F.obj I) ≫
      R.map (schemeMVRestrictionLocalizationChain X Y h W I) ≫
      R.map ((schemeMVOpenRestrictionComparison h W).inv.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)) =
    (let LX := schemeOpenRestriction X (h ⁻¹ᵁ W)
     let J := (LX.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I
     let G := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (h ∣_ W).toLRSHom.toShHom
     let RY := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage W.ι.toLRSHom.toShHom
     let b₀ := (Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso
         (schemeMVUnderivedOpenComposition h W) (.up ℤ) ≪≫
       (Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso (Iso.refl (G ⋙ RY)) (.up ℤ)).symm).hom.app J
     DerivedCategory.Q.map b₀ ≫
       (schemeMVDirectImageLocalization W.ι).app
         ((G.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj J) ≫
       R.map ((schemeMVDirectImageLocalization (h ∣_ W)).app J ≫
         (schemeDerivedDirectImage (h ∣_ W)).map
           (LX.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app I) ≫
         (schemeMVOpenRestrictionComparison h W).inv.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)))

proof.text: Apply schemeMVImageIso_composition_factor in every degree and use extensionality of chain maps. It identifies the image component followed by open direct image of the underived restriction comparison with the complex composition comparison b0. Apply Q to this equation. Naturality of the open direct-image localization unit moves that underived comparison across the unit. Expand open-image localization on Y and the explicit restriction-localization chain. Cancel the inverse and hom of the exact Y-restriction factor inside the open derived direct image. Associativity and functoriality produce the normalized three-map composite. No h-localization or derived composition-unit equation is used.
